name: dumbbell rear delt fly (45 degrees)
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides on an incline of about 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Set a bench to 45 degrees and lie chest down on it, a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang below you with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights out to the sides until your arms are level with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Keep your neck neutral and avoid swinging.
